applies_to: AAON packaged rooftop units, air handlers, DOAS and water-source units controlled by the Orion VCB-X (OE335-26B-VCBX) unit controller.
summary: The VCB-X is the Orion (WattMaster) unit controller used on AAON rooftop units and air handlers. It has an on-board BACnet MS/TP port and serves 51 read-only Analog Inputs (temperatures, humidity, pressures, airflow, setpoint mirrors, output signals, alarm bits), 73 writable Analog Values (setpoints, lockouts, offsets, calibration, fan and damper limits, BAS overrides) and 72 read-only Binary Inputs (enable status, individual alarms, relay status).
notes: AI and BI objects are read-only; AV objects are read/write. Sensor inputs can't be written.
A setpoint written over BACnet is kept in temporary memory until midnight, then saved as the new default; a power cycle before midnight loses it.
Engineering units are not printed in the object table, so units are left blank.
AV 68 is not listed in the guide. AI 43-46 (superheat and expansion valve) are marked 'Not Used'; BI 7 is reserved.
Points for the EM1 expansion module, 12-relay board, MHGRV reheat board, MODGAS-X and Title 24 economizer only report when that hardware is installed.
Source is the VCB-X Controller Field Technical Guide (Orion OR-VCBX-FIELD-TGD-01X), Appendix C.

source.title: VCB-X Controller Field Technical Guide (Appendix C - VCB-X BACnet)

integration.summary: Wire the on-board MS/TP port and set MAC address, device ID and baud on the controller's LCD BACnet screens. Schedule the unit from the BAS with AV 62 Schedule Force, adjust the occupied heating/cooling and supply-air setpoints, and read HVAC mode, control status, temperatures and the alarm BIs. AV 63-65 force the mode, fan speed or OA damper; write Auto to hand control back.

integration.enable: Occupancy comes from AV 62 Schedule Force (0 = follow the controller's schedule, 1 = forced occupied, 2 = forced unoccupied). AV 63 HVAC Mode Override, AV 64 Fan VFD Override and AV 65 Outdoor Air Damper Override force operation; writing Auto (0 for the mode override, 65535 for fan and damper) returns control to the unit.
integration.remote_sensors: Not supported: the guide states sensor inputs can't be written over BACnet.
setup: MAC address 0-254, default 1; set on the LCD BACnet screen.
Device ID up to seven digits, set on the same screen; no default is printed.
BTL listed as a B-ASC (software 2.13): ReadProperty, ReadPropertyMultiple, WriteProperty, no COV.
gotchas: Setpoints written over BACnet only become permanent at midnight; a power cycle before then reverts them.
Setpoints are stored to permanent memory; avoid writing them cyclically.
AI 40 Alarm Status is a bit string; the individual alarms are also available as BI 6-36 and BI 68-72.
Expansion-board, MODGAS, reheat and Title 24 points only report when that hardware is installed.
